filing_office: Alaska Department of Commerce, Community, and Economic Development, Division of Corporations, Business and Professional Licensing
filing_fee_notes: Domestic LLC fee; the biennial report costs 100 separately.
registered_agent_rules: Maintain an Alaska resident individual or an authorized corporation at an actual Alaska location where service can be received. An LLC cannot serve as registered agent.
standard_processing_time: Online filings post immediately. Paper filings normally take 10-15 business days March-September; October-February may exceed 15 business days.
annual_report_due: January 2 every two years, in even-numbered years for entities formed in even-numbered years and odd-numbered years for entities formed in odd-numbered years.
state_tax_registration_agency: Alaska Department of Revenue, Tax Division
unemployment_insurance_agency: Alaska Department of Labor and Workforce Development, Employment Security Tax
plain_english_summary: File Articles of Organization and keep an Alaska registered agent. File the initial report and later biennial reports.
common_mistake: Forgetting the initial report due within six months of formation.
notes: Domestic LLC scope. Initial report is free and due within six months. Tax URL is the official Revenue Online gateway. Name-search URL, paid expedite options, franchise/privilege tax, publication and operating-agreement requirement were not confirmed and are null.
